newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch central bank leaves advances rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Dutch central bank leaves advances rate unchanged.

text.p: The Dutch central bank said on Tuesday it had left its special advances rate unchanged at 2.50 percent for an eight-day money market pact that it will launch at tender on Thursday.
Subscriptions to the new special advances pact will be open between 0800 and 0830 GMT on Thursday and allocations will be announced shortly afterwards.
The new liquidity pact will replace a two-day facility of 13.09 billion guilders expiring on Thursday.
